Package com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai Description

The LaunchDarkly Server-Side AI SDK for Java.

This package and its documented subpackages contain the public API for retrieving, interpolating, and tracking LaunchDarkly AI Configs. Types under com.launchdarkly.sdk.server.ai.internal are implementation detail and are not part of the supported API.
